metadata.description: An interface a service exposes and others consume
A deployable business system made of services
What the enterprise can do, independent of the systems that deliver it
A unit of work that alters a system: a ticket, pull request or change record
A control that belongs to a named control set, such as PCI-DSS
A measure that meets a policy or regulation
Data held by the enterprise: a database, dataset or topic. Metadata only, never row data (HLD 5.2)
A recorded choice and its reason, such as an ADR
An unplanned event that disrupted a service
A card or payment network rulebook the organization must follow (HLD 6 Table 10 example)
A person, recorded by role only (HLD 6 Table 9). No names or contact details.
A rule that governs behaviour, such as change control for payment systems
A versioned set of changes put into an environment
A stated need a change must satisfy
A running unit of software with one owning team
A group that owns things and is accountable for them
A check that shows a change or service behaves as required
